newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: QAF buys stake in PT Indofood.
newsitem.headline: QAF buys stake in PT Indofood.

text.p: Food-based QAF Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to acquire a majority stake in Indonesian noodle maker PT Indofood Sukses Makmur.
QAF said in a statement it had agreed with Anthony Salim and PT Saumber Sampoerna Nusantara to buy a total of 951.62 million shares in the capital of Indofood.
This represents about 52 percent of Indofood's existing share capital.
The shares will be priced at 5,100 rupiah each.
QAF said it was proposing to finance the acquisition through a rights issue of up to 2.21 billion shares at Singapore S$1.00 each with free detachable warrants.
The rights issue will raise between S$2.0-2.2 billion and is on the basis of five rights for every one QAF share.
Controlled by the Salim Group, Indofood is a leading food-related group in Indonesia wih a current market captalisation of about S$6.0 billion.
The Salim Group also holds a majority stake in QAF.
"The acquisiton will allow the enlarged QAF group to have a highly integrated food business that produces market and retail consumer food products," the QAF statement said.
